name: Sjuhäradsleden, etapp 7: Blackered - Prångens Camping
description: Blackered to Prångens Camping. Candidate import from normalized research; verify current notices before publication.
waterSources: No confirmed free potable-water point between Blackered and Prångens Camping: Official text says there are no prepared rest areas on the stage. No reliable drinking-water point was found between Blackered and the Prången endpoint. Carry water.
notes: Naturkartan carries a whole-trail warning that Sjuhäradsleden is not fully quality-assured and may have signage/passability/accessibility shortcomings, while Västsverige says stages 3-7 are quality-assured.
Naturkartan GPX/API and Västsverige KML all contain an 838.6 m chord near Prången/Ulricehamn. OSM corroborates the corridor but is also simplified with a 559.7 m segment.

The Naturkartan route-line endpoint is about 255 m from the converted Borås Prångens Camping coordinate and about 274 m from the KML campsite POI; OSM ends between these. The named endpoint and route-line endpoint should be modeled separately until normalization chooses a policy.
Västsverige still mentions Kommskälet about 2 km from Blackered, but current GTFS/Västtrafik checks found no current stop under Komskälet, Kommskälet or Blackered.
Official text says there are no prepared rest areas along the section, while OSM has benches/waste/picnic micro-amenities near the Prången approach.
Densify/resample the 838.6 m Naturkartan/KML chord and OSM long chord before route import.

facilities.name: Blackered trailhead
facilities.description: Start access area for Etapp 7 at Blackered. Official material says parking and information exist at the endpoint. Deduplicate with section 6 Blackered end access.

facilities.name: Brunns kyrkoruin
facilities.description: Church ruin west of Ulricehamn, highlighted by official tourism for section 7 and likely from the 1100s. Field/blog sources report a collapse-risk warning and reinforcement/bracing; treat it as a heritage POI with caution, not as a trail closure. Verify whether the ruin is legally classified as a building monument/fornlämning and whether any official access restrictions are posted.

facilities.name: Brunnsnäs roadside parking/information
facilities.description: OSM-only access point near the Brunnsnäs/Åsunden side, late in the stage. It is not an official stage endpoint. Verify current public parking rules before user-facing import.

facilities.name: Prångens Camping
facilities.description: Paid endpoint camping/service cluster near Åsunden with tent/camping pitches, cabins, ställplatser, WC, showers, fresh water, kitchen, waste, latrine/greywater handling, cafe, grill area, parking, beach, playground, minigolf and Wi-Fi. Customer/guest utilities should be modeled as paid or opening-hour dependent. Deduplicate with Prångens badplats and endpoint board/parking/toilet objects. Do not model camping utilities as free public trail utilities.

facilities.name: Prångens endpoint information/parking/toilet
facilities.description: Official end access cluster for Etapp 7. Borås PDF shows information, parking and toilet at Prångens Camping; exact object placement is better modeled through the camping/badplats facility cluster when possible. Route-line endpoint, Borås/KML campsite POI and OSM camping polygon do not coincide exactly; deduplicate before normalization.

facilities.name: Åsunden Prången / Prångens badplats
facilities.description: Endpoint bathing-place next to Prångens Camping with shallow sandy beach, 90 m pier, toilet with changing/baby room, canoe rental, minigolf, mini shop, beach volleyball and playground. Deduplicate with Prångens Camping utilities and treat water-quality/current bathing info as dynamic.

facilities.name: Sturebadet / Kallbadhuset cluster
facilities.description: Ulricehamn lakeside service/bathing cluster about 0.5-0.7 km from the section end, with piers, accessible bathing ramp, toilet, grill, sand beach, dog swim, nearby Kallbadhus and cafe/restaurant. Not on the official section endpoint; import only if nearby Ulricehamn services are in scope.
